debrief db-021
1) the actor f-o-r-g-e-d f-a-l-s-e b-r-e-e-d-i-n-g l-o-g-s i-n a s-h-a-r-e-d d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t r-e-p-o-s-i-t-o-r-y and left a m-u-d-d-i-e-d a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p f-o-r o-r-i-g-i-n s-o-u-r-c-i-n-g
2) the actor f-a-b-r-i-c-a-t-e-d o-w-n-e-r-s-h-i-p c-h-a-i-n d-e-t-a-i-l-s in a s-e-p-a-r-a-t-e l-e-d-g-e-r and left d-i-s-c-o-n-n-e-c-t-e-d t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n h-i-s-t-o-r-i-e-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-r-o-s-s-r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e c-h-e-c-k f-o-r p-r-e-v-i-o-u-s k-e-e-p-e-r s-i-g-n-a-t-u-r-e-s
3) the actor d-u-p-l-i-c-a-t-e-d l-i-c-e-n-s-e d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s in a p-h-o-t-o e-d-i-t-o-r and left t-a-m-p-e-r-e-d p-d-f f-i-l-e-s with m-i-s-c-h a-n-g-e-d m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the v-a-l-i-d-i-t-y c-h-e-c-k f-o-r a-g-e-n-c-y s-t-a-m-p-s
4) the actor p-u-b-l-i-s-h-e-d o-n-l-i-n-e l-i-s-t-i-n-g-s with c-l-a-i-m-s of c-a-p-t-i-v-e o-r-i-g-i-n and left a f-r-o-z-e-n s-c-r-e-e-n-s-h-o-t a-r-c-h-i-v-e of t-h-e a-d-v-e-r-t-i-s-e-m-e-n-t-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the l-a-b-e-l-i-n-g c-h-e-c-k f-o-r s-p-e-c-i-e-s s-t-a-t-u-s
5) the actor r-e-t-a-i-n-e-d t-h-e s-e-a-l-e-d m-a-t-t-e-r f-i-l-e and left a s-t-a-t-i-c c-o-p-y of t-h-e c-l-o-s-e-d e-x-h-i-b-i-t in a l-o-c-a-l f-o-l-d-e-r while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the d-e-s-t-r-u-c-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k f-o-r r-e-d-u-n-d-a-n-t r-e-c-o-r-d-s
